description: RUGGED, VERSATILE, V6-POWERED, FOUR-WHEEL DRIVE, CREW CAB, TIMING-BELT SERVICED, NONSMOKER, THE PICKUP WITH A TRUNK IN THE BED! Some pickups just haul. The 2013 Honda Ridgeline Sport 4WD Crew Cab does that and a whole lot more, and this Alabaster Silver Metallic example, with the odometer hovering around the 124,400-mile mark, pairs a Black interior with 18-inch black alloy wheels, fog lights, rear privacy glass and a bed with a lockable trunk built right into the floor. Under the hood, the 3.5-liter VTEC V6 delivers 250 horsepower and 247 lb-ft of torque through a 5-speed automatic transmission, while Honda's VTM-4 four-wheel-drive system sends power where it is needed. It is smooth, confident power that feels as comfortable on the commute as it does on the way to the lake house. The history shows real care. CARFAX reports 21 service records, including a major service at a Honda dealer in May 2026 that covered a new timing belt, tensioner, water pump and serpentine belt along with a coolant flush and transmission fluid change, and the odometer works out to roughly 9,500 miles per year since the Ridgeline was first delivered in 2013. Why Shoppers Buy This Model The Ridgeline is the pickup that drives like an SUV. Its car-based, unibody construction gives it a smooth, quiet ride, and features like the In-Bed Trunk and the dual-action tailgate make it more clever than your average truck. Edmunds' owner reviews give it 4.7 out of 5 stars, with owners praising its smooth, quiet ride and its ability to handle everything from hiking trips to hauling projects. Shoppers typically cross-shop the Ridgeline with the Toyota Tacoma, the Nissan Frontier and the Chevrolet Colorado. Many choose the Honda for its comfortable crew cab, its refined road manners and the practical, weatherproof storage that no other pickup offers. Automotive Press and Industry Recognition Edmunds' owner reviews give the Honda Ridgeline an average of 4.7 out of 5 stars, with 88 percent of reviewers giving it five stars. Warranty The odometer on this Ridgeline currently reads 124,352 miles. The original 3-year, 36,000-mile Honda basic and 5-year, 60,000-mile powertrain factory warranty coverage has expired, so this Ridgeline is offered on the strength of its condition and its documented history. CARFAX shows the kind of consistent care that matters on a truck with this mileage, including a brake pad and rotor replacement, brake fluid flush, alignment and tire rotation in August 2025, and the major timing belt and water pump service at a Honda dealer in May 2026. Extended service plans may be available for buyers who want added peace of mind. Standard Features The Sport is where the Ridgeline gets its attitude. 18-inch black alloy wheels with all-season tires, a black grille, fog lights, rear privacy glass, a rearview camera, cruise control, a 6-speaker, 100-watt audio system, a leather-wrapped steering wheel and a dual-action tailgate make it feel like a step above a typical midsize pickup. Truck Capability The Ridgeline is ready to work and play. Honda rates it to tow up to 5,000 pounds and haul a payload of about 1,546 pounds when properly equipped, with a gross vehicle weight rating of about 6,050 pounds. The 5-foot bed measures 60 inches long (about 6.6 feet with the tailgate down), 49.5 inches wide between the wheel wells and roughly 55 inches wide at its widest point, with an estimated depth of about 16 inches, wide enough to lay 4-by-8 sheets flat. The In-Bed Trunk is the Ridgeline's party trick. Under the bed floor sits a lockable, weatherproof compartment of about 8.5 cubic feet that is perfect for tools, groceries, a cooler or wet gear, and it even drains so it can double as an ice chest. The dual-action tailgate folds down like a regular truck or swings open like a door for easy access to the bed and the trunk. The truck measures 206.9 inches long, 77.8 inches wide with mirrors and 70.3 inches tall on a 122-inch wheelbase with 8.2 inches of ground clearance, and weighs roughly 4,500 pounds at the curb. Honda lists a gross combined weight rating of about 10,085 pounds, and payload and bed depth figures should be confirmed against the door-jamb label. Mechanical Features A 3.5-liter VTEC V6 delivers 250 horsepower and 247 lb-ft of torque, and the EPA rates this four-wheel-drive Ridgeline at 15 miles per gallon in the city, 21 on the highway and 17 combined. The 5-speed automatic with Grade Logic Control keeps shifts smooth and well matched to the engine. VTM-4 four-wheel drive adds traction and confidence in rain, snow and on the trail, and with a ground clearance of 8.2 inches and a four-wheel independent suspension, the Ridgeline stays composed and comfortable on the road. A 22-gallon fuel tank keeps the miles between fill-ups long. Exterior Features Alabaster Silver Metallic paint gives the Ridgeline a clean, bright look that suits its distinctive shape. The 18-inch black alloy wheels, black grille and fog lights give the Sport a sharper, more athletic look, and rear privacy glass adds a finishing touch. Interior Features Step inside and the Ridgeline feels like a roomy, well-organized cabin. The Black interior, a leather-wrapped steering wheel and a crew cab with seating for five give everyone room to stretch out, and the 60/40 lift-up rear seat folds up to reveal underseat storage for taller items. Air conditioning, power windows and remote keyless entry keep daily driving simple, and steering-wheel audio controls keep your attention where it belongs. Infotainment & Technology A 6-speaker, 100-watt audio system with CD and MP3 playback and an auxiliary input keeps the music going on every drive, and steering-wheel audio controls make it easy to adjust without taking your hands off the wheel. A rearview camera helps with parking and backing up to a trailer. Safety Features Vehicle Stability Assist with traction control, four-wheel antilock brakes with electronic brake distribution and Brake Assist, dual-stage front airbags, front side airbags and side curtain airbags work in the background to help you stay aware and in control. LATCH child-seat anchors, tire pressure monitoring and an engine immobilizer add another layer of confidence for the whole family. ... and there's SO MUCH more! If available, vehicle files can be found above this description on our website, including the original brochure and window sticker! The Bottom Line This Ridgeline Sport brings a lot of truck to one polished package: around 124,400 miles of well-documented service, a timing belt and water pump service completed in May 2026, 250 horsepower, VTM-4 four-wheel drive, a 5,000-pound tow rating and an In-Bed Trunk that no other pickup can match. It is a practical, comfortable and clever way to get a capable truck. Bed trunk packed, tailgate swung open and ready for the weekend. Vantage Auto Collection is proud to offer this absolutely stunning 2017 Lamborghini Hurac n LP 580-2 Spyder, finished in a gorgeous matte gray exterior over a black leather interior. With just 16,000 miles, exceptional cosmetic condition, and a recent Lamborghini Certified sale accompanied by extensive servicing, this is unquestionably one of the finest examples you'll find anywhere.

Powered by Lamborghini's legendary naturally aspirated 5.2-liter V10 producing 572 horsepower, the LP 580-2 delivers one of the most exhilarating driving experiences of any modern exotic. Unlike its all-wheel-drive siblings, the LP 580-2 sends its power exclusively to the rear wheels, providing a more engaging, playful, and pure driving experience. Paired with Lamborghini's lightning-fast seven-speed dual-clutch transmission, the Hurac n accelerates from 0 to 60 mph in approximately 3.6 seconds while producing one of the most intoxicating exhaust notes in the automotive world. With the top down and that glorious V10 singing behind you, few automobiles can match the experience.

What truly separates this particular Hurac n from the others is its exceptional history and condition. In September 2025, just approximately 1,000 miles ago, this Lamborghini was sold as a Lamborghini Certified vehicle. At that time, it underwent comprehensive servicing, including new tires, fluid services, and additional maintenance. This is an incredibly important distinction when shopping for a pre-owned exotic, as proper maintenance and preparation can make all the difference.

Cosmetically, this Hurac n is simply spectacular. The matte gray finish beautifully accentuates Lamborghini's unmistakable angular design, aggressive front fascia, sculpted side intakes, and low, wide stance. Contrasting black wheels and red brake calipers complete an absolutely stunning combination. The body is in pristine condition, while the interior presents equally beautifully, showing virtually no signs of its 16,000 miles. Every aspect of this car reflects the exceptional care it has received.

The Spyder's power-operated convertible top transforms this already remarkable supercar into an entirely different experience. Enjoy the unmistakable sound of the V10 with the roof open, or close it for a more refined driving experience. The Hurac n manages to combine breathtaking performance, exotic styling, and surprisingly usable everyday driving manners in a package that remains one of Lamborghini's greatest modern creations.

With Lamborghini having moved away from naturally aspirated V10 power in its newest generation of supercars, the Hurac n represents the end of a truly special era. The combination of rear-wheel drive, open-air motoring, and a high-revving naturally aspirated V10 makes the LP 580-2 Spyder particularly desirable among enthusiasts.

Finding a Hurac n is easy. Finding one with just 16,000 miles, a recent Lamborghini Certified sale, extensive recent servicing, and this level of cosmetic perfection is another story entirely.

This is an exceptional example that needs absolutely nothing and is ready to be enjoyed by its next owner. We welcome your inspection and are confident this Hurac n will exceed expectations. Nationwide enclosed transportation is available.

Ferrari Silicon Valley is proud to present this exceptionally desirable Pre-Owned 2003 Ferrari 360 Spider. Finished in elegant Grigio Titanio over a sophisticated Charcoal leather interior, and showing just 25,940 miles, this timeless open-top Ferrari is equipped with its highly coveted factory 6-Speed manual transmission, making it one of the most sought-after analog Ferraris for enthusiasts and collectors alike.
The 360 Spider ushered in Ferrari's all-aluminum sports car era, combining lightweight engineering with timeless Pininfarina styling and exhilarating naturally aspirated V8 performance. Finished in refined Grigio Titanio, this example exudes understated sophistication while the power-operated convertible top transforms every drive into an unforgettable open-air experience. Its sculpted bodywork and perfectly balanced proportions continue to define one of Ferrari's most iconic modern designs.


Inside, the cabin is beautifully appointed in premium Charcoal leather, creating a purposeful yet luxurious driving environment. The striking Daytona seats with Nero inserts add a distinctive sporting touch while providing outstanding comfort and support. Electric seats offer convenient power adjustability, and the centerpiece of the cockpit is the legendary factory 6-Speed manual transmission, complete with Ferrari's iconic gated shifter that delivers one of the purest and most rewarding driving experiences ever offered by the marque.

Engine and Performance: At the heart of the 360 Spider lies a naturally aspirated 3.6 liter V8 engine producing 395 horsepower and 275 lb-ft of torque, paired with the highly desirable factory 6-Speed manual transmission. Delivering crisp throttle response, precise gear changes, and one of Ferrari's most unforgettable naturally aspirated exhaust notes, the 360 Spider accelerates from 0 to 60 mph in approximately 4.5 seconds. Its lightweight aluminum chassis, perfectly balanced mid-engine layout, and gated manual gearbox combine to create one of the purest analog driving experiences in Ferrari history.

Key Features:

• Factory 6-Speed Manual Transmission: The iconic gated manual gearbox delivering one of Ferrari's most engaging and collectible driving experiences.

• Daytona Seats with Nero Inserts: Signature Ferrari seating featuring contrasting Nero inserts that enhance both the cabin's sporting appearance and occupant support.

• Electric Seats: Provide exceptional comfort and convenient power adjustability for both driver and passenger.

This 2003 Ferrari 360 Spider is far more than just a car, it is the embodiment of the brand's commitment to peak automotive engineering and opulent design. Available at Ferrari Silicon Valley, this vehicle offers an invitation to own one of Ferrari's most celebrated modern classics, combining timeless styling, naturally aspirated V8 performance, and the unmatched engagement of a factory gated manual transmission.
